method: Same agent directly operated the local production build with CUA in an isolated IAB ?demo=1 tab. No human participants or subagents.
clock: CDP Date override only in the temporary demo tab, plus focus/visibilitychange. Operating system time and user review tab untouched. Temporary viewport reset. Reload discarded the first mock; the final mock belongs only to the temporary tab that closes at turn end.

observations.scenario: Mixed memo with shared today date
observations.observed: Four recognized tasks; two due today; plan 3→5, future dates remained outside the existing plan.

observations.scenario: Existing future deadline changed to today, before fix
observations.observed: The editor remained unchecked and the task remained outside today; outside-due banner showed 1.

observations.scenario: Midnight during edited memo preview, after fix
observations.observed: Heading date 11/20→11/21, edited title and original deadlines preserved, save disabled until date confirmation. Checked and saved; plan 3→5. Mobile 390×844 kept warning and confirmation readable.
Added batch removed, plan 5→3, original memo restored. Reparsed original using 11/21; today deadline moved to 11/21 and tomorrow to 11/22.

observations.scenario: Deadline editing and undo, after fix
observations.observed: Changed 11/22 deadline to today 11/21; today checkbox selected and saved plan 4→5. Undo restored original deadline and plan 5→4.

observations.scenario: Next-day completion undo and finish guard
observations.observed: Completed book return on 11/21, moved to 11/22, undid completion. New 3-item plan preserved; restored overdue item appeared in outside-due warning. After 3/3, finish was blocked and corrective action offered.

observations.scenario: Plan-action undo expiry and deletion undo
observations.observed: Added remaining due item; next day 11/23 generated new plan, disabled previous-plan undo with explanation. Deleted a planned task: plan 3→2, total 5→4. Undo restored task and plan 2→3, total 4→5.

Fresh demo, limit 1, completed original book task, opened an excluded future task and edited its title. At 11/23 the inclusion checkbox followed the new plan and the draft title survived. Save kept it as the new today task, 0/1.
